checks.note: The audit schema requires both identity fields, but a manifest mismatch only logs and increments a metric before the computed type ID is accepted. The only manifest loader reads a fixed release file; inspection of identity, startup, release, deployment, and infrastructure files found no store registering the mismatching ID. Thus records can carry an ID that does not resolve to a stored manifest. The random process instance UUID also has no explicit pod mapping in the supplied configuration.

The agent maps to the platform team and an externally managed SSO on-call group. CODEOWNERS and README add team and channel names, but the repository does not establish the group's current operator or rotation. External SSO/rotation configuration would be needed to decide this check.

Revoking this principal contains that agent type independently of launching-user credentials. The stop flags support global and tenant scope rather than instance targeting, but the check allows type containment as an alternative.
